mainFields.obligations:
COMMERCIAL / PAYMENT — AED  512,506.76 excluding VAT, final fixed total including expenses (p4 cl 5). Monthly payments within 30  days after invoice submission accompanied by approved, duly signed Service Completion Form confirming satisfactory delivery (p23 App3). Actual invoice/payment/completion status is unverified. Printed annual fee lines are preserved as annual packages; original quantities and monthly figures are in fee descriptions. Monthly figures total AED  42,708.90; ×12 is AED  512,506.80, AED  0.04 above the annual total. Do not silently rebalance.

PENALTIES / LIABILITY — Failure to supply services/materials or delay beyond the granted period permits measures under Dubai Law 12/2020 and relevant laws (pp3–4 cl 4; p16 cl 12.16). No numeric penalty rate, service credit formula or penalty capis specified. A supplier exemption application needs proof of emergency, force majeure, customer-caused delay or another cause outside supplier control, and customer consent. The compensation paragraph states a 100% contract-value liability limit; indirect/consequential losses and lost profit are excluded with exceptions for gross negligence, fraud or confidentiality breach (pp13–14 cl 12.9). This liability limit is not a delay-penalty cap.

GUARANTEE / RENEWAL / TERMINATION — Final unconditional irrevocable bank guarantee: 10% of contract value, from a bank operating in the State, effective from start and valid 90  days after contract end; revocation requires customer consent. Actual guarantee provision is unverified (p4 cl 5.3). Customer written intention to renew 30  days before expiry; no unconditional automatic renewal (p3 cl 2). Unrectified breach:15  working-day cure after written notice (p9 cl 9.1). Customer early termination: at least 30  days written notice, paying value of supplied materials/services (p10 cl 9.2). Force-majeure notice within 7  working  days with details, supporting proof and mitigation; timeline extension by agreement (pp18–19 cl 14). Amicable dispute period 30  days, then senior management; Dubai law/UAE federal law and Dubai Courts (p11 cl 10).

GOVERNANCE — Changes need an authorized mutual written addendum. Customer written consent is required for subcontracting/assignment and use of its IP, name or logo; supplier remains liable. Confidentiality/security survive expiry; return customer materials on request/end. Apply proportionate ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 22301, ISR/DESC/cloud and applicable PCI DSS controls. Maintain HSE and continuity. Customer audit/offset rights apply. Arabic prevails if versions differ. (Clauses 3,6–8,12–16.)
